firm_data.firm_description: Shook, Hardy & Bacon L.L.P. is a top-ranked trial and litigation firm serving health, science, and technology companies. For more than a century, the firm has defended companies in their most substantial national and international products liability, mass tort and complex litigation matters.
notable_facts: Expanded to 18 offices, including Atlanta, Boston, Hartford, Los Angeles, New York City and St. Louis.
The firm’s analyst program continues to attract professionals with high-level degrees in scientific and technical fields.
Shook’s total pro bono hours increased by more than 30%.
technology_signals: Promotes cutting-edge technology and the use of artificial intelligence to advance the interests of clients

email.subject: AI for Shook, Hardy & Bacon, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Bart,

Shook's expansion to 18 offices while maintaining your focus on cutting-edge technology and AI caught my attention. That balance, between scale and innovation, is exactly what we see at the firms winning in product liability and mass tort work right now.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of high-stakes practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like Shook compete at the highest levels.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
